title: Partitioning Using Number Line Method
objective: Partition various wholes precisely into equal parts using a number line method.
note: This is a hands-on exploratory lesson using notebook paper and straight edges.

problems.text: Describe step by step the experience you had of partitioning a length into equal units by simply using a piece of notebook paper and a straight edge. Illustrate the process.

activity_description: Students use lined notebook paper placed at an angle to partition strips into equal parts. The lines on the paper help create equal divisions without measuring.
